# Dashboards, panels and data sources (generated by `gateway/tools/gen_dashboard_sources.mjs`; do not edit)

State shown by each panel on a gateway with **no data at all**, in platform scope and in tenant scope. `NO_DATA` = the source exists and is empty; `NOT_INSTRUMENTED` = nothing produces this data yet; `NOT_APPLICABLE` = the panel does not exist in that scope. A panel never shows `0` for absence. Test traffic is excluded through `telemetry_exclusions` and sandbox/synthetic data classes never reach these tables. GitHub request counters are labelled requests served by GitHub, never unique users.

Dashboards: 11 (overview, downloads, api, premium, cost, crm, comparison, retention, pipeline, signatures, cas_backups).
